title: Euro 2012: Mario Balotelli scores twice in 2-1 Italian win
content: # Euro 2012: Mario Balotelli scores twice in 2-1 Italian win. WARSAW, POLAND - JUNE 28: Mario Balotelli of Italy controls the ball as he runs through to score his team's second goal during the UEFA EURO 2012 semi final match between Germany and Italy at the National Stadium on June 28, 2012 in Warsaw, Poland. Mario Balotelli of Italy controls the ball as he runs through to score his team's second goal during the UEFA EURO 2012 semi final match between Germany and Italy  Joern Pollex/Getty Images. (CBS News) The outspoken and often-temperamental Mario Balotelli was all smiles in Warsaw today as the Italian national team knocked Germany out of Euro 2012. The striker scored both of Italy's goals in a 2-1 semi-final match that was all but over by half-time. In the 20th minute of the first half, Italian forward Antonio Cassano managed to work the ball to the edge of Germany's penalty box.
